from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAssetRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of Total Assets extracted from a single company's financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company filing the report")
    total_assets_value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of Total Assets")
    total_assets_unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the value (e.g., 'thousands', 'dollars', 'millions')")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report period ended")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the asset figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    asset_records: list[CompanyAssetRecord]
